tcs.test_item:
The software shall enable/disable GPS time synchronization based on NAV_Presence, GPS_Presence, and user settings
(confirm GPS time is enabled only when the NAV Proxi parameter is present)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
Proxi NAV_Presence is set to 1 (Present)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Read the state of "Set Time Hours" and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. "Set Time Hours" is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-5 CFTS015 缺件物件 6151331
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814075 標為 Atlantis Mid）
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814085 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813922 之條件為 Proxi $NAV_Presence$ = [Present] 且設定已開啟。NAV_Presence 為 PROXI 參數（值域取自 data/proxi_atlantis_high.tsv，Atlantis & Atlantis High (col 16-20, Proxi sheet)），**非 CAN 訊號**，故寫入前置條件而不寫訊號三件組。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall enable/disable GPS time synchronization based on NAV_Presence, GPS_Presence, and user settings
(confirm the manual set-time feature returns when GPS sync is switched off)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
Proxi NAV_Presence is set to 1 (Present)
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to OFF
3. Read the state of "Set Time Hours" and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows OFF
3. "Set Time Hours" is available for entry
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814087 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813939 逐字：ON 時 disable the 'SET TIME' feature，OFF 時 enable —— 本條驗 OFF 方向。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall enable/disable GPS time synchronization based on NAV_Presence, GPS_Presence, and user settings
(confirm GPS time is not enabled when the NAV Proxi parameter is absent)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
Proxi NAV_Presence is set to 0 (Absent)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Read the state of "Sync Time with GPS" and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" is not available
tcs.reasoning: 4813922 之條件之反面。值域 0 = Absent 取自 proxi_atlantis_high.tsv。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall use internal clock when GPS data is temporarily unavailable and switch back when available
(confirm the internal clock takes over when the GPS signal is lost)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
GPS signal is available
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
2. PENDING: DR-10 Bench 使 GPS 訊號不可用之操作方式
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU display shows the GPS clock value
2. The GPS signal is unavailable
3. The HU display continues to advance from the last GPS value using the internal clock
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814084 標為 Atlantis Mid）
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814100 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813950 逐字：GPS TIME ON 時以內部時鐘為 backup（GPS signal lost condition）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall use internal clock when GPS data is temporarily unavailable and switch back when available
(confirm the GPS clock resumes once the signal returns)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON

PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814102 標為 Atlantis Mid）

tcs.test_item:
The software shall use internal clock when GPS data is temporarily unavailable and switch back when available
(confirm the internally calculated time is sent until the GPS data is ready)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is OFF
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the ignition to ON
2. Read $GPSDateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_UTC_Hour on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
2. $GPSDateTmHour$ carries a value from the first transmission onward
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.reasoning: 4813959：GPS 資料備妥前送內部計算之時間，備妥後取代之。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 857（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain internal clock with ±2 sec accuracy per 24 hours when GPS is unavailable
(confirm the internal clock drift stays within the allowed error over a 24 hour period)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.input_test_data: Reference time source accurate to 1 second
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Time Hours" and "Set Time Minutes" to the reference time
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it 24 hours later
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The HU time matches the reference time
3. The HU time differs from the reference time by no more than 2 seconds
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-5 CFTS015 缺件物件 6151328
tcs.reasoning: 4813936 逐字：+/- 2 seconds for each twenty four hour period (86400 seconds)。±2 秒為允許誤差之邊界，故取 BVA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit GPS-based date/time signals or SNA if unavailable
(confirm the GPS date fields are broadcast on the bus)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
GPS signal is available
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read $GPSDateTmYear$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Year on FD and record it
2. Read $GPSDateTmMonth$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Month on FD and record it
3. Read $GPSDateTmDay$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. $GPSDateTmYear$ carries the current GPS year
2. $GPSDateTmMonth$ carries the current GPS month
3. $GPSDateTmDay$ carries the current GPS day
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814098 標為 Atlantis Mid）
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814103 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813999 逐字列出三個 GPS 日期訊號。**本條不涵蓋 SNA 送出規則** —— 該規則屬 022（B-2 界線，R-TM55：該對無自動判準，人工確認）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 856 / 859 / 861（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:

tcs.test_procedure:

PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814105 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4813999 之送出隨 GPS 資料變動。**不涵蓋 SNA**（B-2 界線）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 856（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain an internal calendar and act as master for vehicle date (2010–2099 range)
(confirm the head unit keeps and transmits the vehicle date as master)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 15 / 06 / 2030
3. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The HU display shows 15/06/2030
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4814006 為 Radio 作為 vehicle date 之 master；4814011 之 a) 明訂依 Day/Month/Year Setting.Info 更新內部日期計數。UI 項名取自 HMI Settings List 第 7 節（Set Date Day / Month / Year）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall initialize time/date to default values after reset or battery reconnection
(confirm the date returns to its initial value after a battery reconnection)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
A date other than the initial value has been set
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the vehicle battery
2. Turn the ignition to ON
3. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The battery is reconnected
2. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
3. The HU display shows 1 January of the model year
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814118 標為 Atlantis Mid）
PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814121 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 4814028 逐字：initialized to '1st of January of the year of $VC_Model_Year$'。$VC_Model_Year$ 為車輛配置參數而**非 CAN 訊號**，故不寫訊號三件組。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain time using internal counters during sleep and update on wakeup
(confirm the time continues to advance across a sleep and wakeup cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
2. PENDING: DR-9 CAN sleep 之可觀察終止條件
3. Wake the CAN bus
4. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU display shows a time value
2. The CAN bus has entered sleep
3. The CAN bus is awake
4. The HU display shows the time advanced by the elapsed duration
tcs.spec_reference: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814066 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 021 之唯一引用物件 4814066 標為 Atlantis Mid（`12` §2.2：Atl-Hi 錨點為零），依 R-TM64 之零真值例外，spec_reference 寫單一佔位，明細入 Remarks。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain time using internal counters during sleep and update on wakeup
(confirm the time is updated on the bus after wakeup)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is asleep
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the CAN bus
2. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus is awake
2. $DateTmHour$ carries the current hour value
tcs.spec_reference: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-11 Atl-H 對應需求（CFTS015-4814066 標為 Atlantis Mid）
tcs.reasoning: 021 之 update on wakeup。spec_reference 同前條之零真值例外。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。
